from typing import Literal
import mas_operators as operator
from . import prompt as prompt_custom
from scripts.async_llm import create_llm_instance


from scripts.evaluator import DatasetType

class Workflow:
    def __init__(
        self,
        name: str,
        llm_config,
        dataset: DatasetType,
        aggregator_llm_config=None,
    ) -> None:
        self.name = name
        self.dataset = dataset
        self.llm = create_llm_instance(llm_config)
        self.aggregator_llm = create_llm_instance(aggregator_llm_config) if aggregator_llm_config else self.llm

    async def __call__(self, problem: str):
        shared = operator.SharedMemory(worker_llm=self.llm, aggregator_llm=self.aggregator_llm, num_agents=3, num_rounds=2,
            worker_prompts=[prompt_custom.BINARIO_SHARED_BUILD, prompt_custom.BINARIO_SHARED_CHECK, prompt_custom.BINARIO_SHARED_REPAIR],
            aggregator_prompt=prompt_custom.BINARIO_SHARED_SUMMARY)
        draft = await shared(problem)
        star = operator.Star(worker_llm=self.llm, aggregator_llm=self.aggregator_llm, num_agents=3,
            worker_prompts=[prompt_custom.BINARIO_FINALIZE_FROM_DRAFT] * 3,
            aggregator_prompt=prompt_custom.BINARIO_AGGREGATOR_STRICT_PICK)
        solution = await star(f"{problem}\n\nDraft candidate from previous stage:\n{draft.get('response', 'No draft available.')}")
        return (solution.get("response") or draft.get("response") or "```text\nNo valid solution exists for the given Binario puzzle.\n```"), {
            "worker": self.llm.get_usage_delta(),
            "aggregator": self.aggregator_llm.get_usage_delta(),
        }
